title: Data Processing and Preparation of MALDI IMS Data
author: Nathan Heath Patterson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bed3ja8n

steps.title: Normalize spectra by total ion current
steps.instruction: For each spectrum, divide every intensity value by the sum of all intensities in that spectrum to achieve total ion current normalization.

steps.title: Generate mean spectrum across dataset
steps.instruction: Compute a mean spectrum by averaging the intensity of each mass bin across all spectra in the dataset.

steps.title: Internally recalibrate mean spectrum
steps.instruction: Recalibrate the mean spectrum using well‑known, spectrally ubiquitous lipid species and retain the resulting calibration equation.

steps.title: Extract pixel-wise peak intensities
steps.instruction: For every pixel, use the provided identified mass list (Lipid Annotation of MALDI IMS Datasets), invert the calibration coefficients to obtain original‑calibration m/z values, and pull matching intensity values from the Bruker .sqlite file.

steps.title: Create data table of peaks
steps.instruction: Assemble the extracted peak list into a table with columns: x, y, m/z 1, m/z 2, m/z 3 … where each m/z column corresponds to an identified lipid species.

steps.title: Import table into R and create experiment
steps.instruction: Read the table into R and use the Cardinal package to create a MSImagingExperiment object from the pixel coordinates and peak intensity values (see https://cardinalmsi.org).

steps.title: Export experiment to imzML file
steps.instruction: Apply Cardinal's writeImzML() function to write the MSImagingExperiment object to an imzML file.
